_doc.zh: 说话用的视位（口形）表。方法取自 JALI（jali2016，已打开）：口形分解为 静止 + JA·（下颌 + 舌）+ LI·唇的动作单元；四条构音约束（双唇音必须闭唇；唇齿音下唇必须碰上齿；咝音下颌几乎合上；非鼻音发音时唇要张开过）；协同发音的习惯（重复的视位并成一个；lipHeavy 的视位提前开始、推迟结束，并取代邻居的唇形，邻居是双唇音 / 唇齿音时则同时发；tongueOnly 的视位不影响唇；很短的塞音 / 鼻音不影响下颌）；视位在音开始前 120 ms 起、结束后 120 ms 消退，唇前突的为 150 ms。音的分类（classes）取自它的附录 A。每个视位具体的下颌开度、AU 强度、舌的姿势都是本项目的假设。音素记号是 ARPAbet 风格的，归并方式也是本项目定的。
_doc.en: The table of visemes (mouth shapes) for speech. Method from JALI (jali2016, opened): a mouth shape is rest + JA·(jaw + tongue) + LI·lip action units; four articulation constraints (bilabials must close the lips; labiodentals must touch the lower lip to the upper teeth; sibilants nearly close the jaw; non-nasals must open the lips at some point); co-articulation habits (duplicated visemes merge; lip-heavy visemes start early, end late and replace the lip shape of neighbours, or sound together with them when those are bilabial / labiodental; tongue-only visemes do not affect the lips; very short obstruents / nasals do not affect the jaw); a viseme starts 120 ms before its sound and decays over 120 ms after it, 150 ms for lip protrusion. The sound classes (`classes`) follow its appendix A. Each viseme's jaw opening, AU intensities and tongue pose are this project's assumptions. Phoneme symbols are ARPAbet-style and the grouping is this project's too.

note.zh: 120 ms 和 150 ms 取自 JALI 第 4.2 节（已读）。shortSeconds 是“短于一帧”的一帧：原文没有说帧率，这里取 1/24 秒，是假设。
note.en: The 120 ms and 150 ms are from section 4.2 of JALI (read). shortSeconds is the one frame of "shorter than one frame": the paper does not state a frame rate in what was read, and 1/24 s is assumed here.

note.zh: 假设：由原始声学特征驱动时的参数。open = 1 对应下颌张开 openJaw × jaw.max；round > 0 混入 roundViseme 的唇形，< 0 混入 spreadViseme 的；closure ≥ closureThreshold 视为“有闭合、部位不明”，做成一般的双唇闭合；每个特征的幅度乘以 min(1, 置信度 / confidenceRef)；时间常数 smoothSeconds 的一阶平滑；level 低于 levelFloor 时回到静止。dental 特征不可靠，不使用。
note.en: Assumptions: parameters of the raw-feature route. open = 1 maps to a jaw opening of openJaw × jaw.max; round > 0 blends in the lip shape of roundViseme and < 0 that of spreadViseme; closure ≥ closureThreshold counts as "a closure of unknown place" and becomes a generic lip closure; every feature's amplitude is multiplied by min(1, confidence / confidenceRef); a one-pole smoothing with time constant smoothSeconds; below levelFloor the mouth returns to rest. The dental feature is unreliable and is not used.
